svg.title: A deed earns its place in the game.
svg.desc: Find an earned property at level 25 or acquire a deed through paid mint or trade. Minting is separate from character identity purchase. A wallet-held deed receives no new stocks. Unlock, approve and equip to registered living-character custody. Stock rewards then require Broker and delivery eligibility. A killer takes equipped deeds and attached stocks; safe release requires 24-hour notice and pauses new rewards immediately. Non-player death routes to the heir after a 24-hour on-chain estate delay. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: src/deeddiscovery.js:8; src/deedcustodychain.js:102; src/deedcustody.js:315; omerta-contracts/src/CharacterDeedCustody.sol:202.

g.text: Non-player death: the heir waits 24 hours after on-chain recording.
Wallet-held deeds earn no new stocks. Character identity is separate.
